suite: npm test (node --test attack.test.cjs); it exits 0 whether or not each attack works, so the invariants below are what decide

invariants.statement: The bridge's programs run /usr/local/bin/node (checked through /proc/self/exe); /work and /work/bin are root:root 0755; the planted node never ran (no /tmp/hostile-node-ran).
After the suite rewrote /work/src/src/lib.js, bridge read_file src/lib.js returns the original sealed content and list_files shows no backdoor.js.
harness/source-read-digest.json digest equals the digest in source-manifest.json and the report contract finds no SOURCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH.
No uid-10001 process outlives the suite except the sandbox's own; the setsid sleeper is gone and its pid is in existing-test-results-<key>.json killedProcesses.
The forged /out/lifecycle.json says lost, but the host's harness/host/lifecycle.json stays running, harness/host is not mounted into the container, and the orchestrator's loss signal never fires.
The forged log and suite output containing 'usage limit reached' do not classify as usage_limit; only a structured RPC error does.
